thread:
Priya Rao: Hi everyone — I'm Priya, starting today as a backend infra engineer on eng-platform. Excited to join Redwood! Quick Q: I haven't received VPN or GitHub invites yet. Also macbook arriving today, any tips for getting dev env up fast? Fun fact: I brew my own chai.
Kaleb H: welcome Priya!! :tada: you should have a GitHub invite — check email + spam. I'll ping infra. For Mac, we prefer Homebrew + asdf for runtimes. Manual: https://redwood.devex/quickstart
Maya P: welcome! People Ops sent your onboarding schedule earlier today — LMK if you didn't get it, I'll re-send.
Jamal R: added you to the SRE group, but VPN needs Okta enroll. Did you get an email from Okta? If not, tell me your personal email and I'll resend.
Priya Rao: thanks! I did get an Okta email but the MFA step fails with my phone (android). Is there a backup option?
Kaleb H: yeah use the Okta Verify app or set up a YubiKey if you have one. I'll drop a step-by-step in a sec.
Alicia (devex): sent a GitHub invite again and added your SSH key request ticket: #12345. If you paste your public key here I'll forward it.
Priya Rao: pasted key (starts with ssh-ed25519 AAAA...). Also getting a failing `yarn install` on mac — arm64 node got weird.
Kaleb H: try `arch -x86_64 brew install node@16` or use `asdf` with nodejs 16/18. If you still see errors paste the build log.
infra-bot: [system] GitHub invite resent to priya@personal.email.com
Jamal R: Okta support note: if Android Verify is flaky, use SMS backup or reach out to helpdesk@redwood.com. I've escalated if you need a new device token.
Priya Rao: awesome, thanks all. Small Q for the week — anyone up for a 30min pairing session on day 2 to walk through local infra? :coffee: 
Kaleb H: me and Jamal can do 10:30am Wed. I'll set up a calendar invite.
Maya P: welcome again! company lunch Thurs if you're free — we'll grab sandwiches. :sandwich: 
Priya Rao: love it, see you all — excited to get started! :wave:
